scope: historical R5.24 locked generative_r5_13 entries below, plus separately versioned R5.26 read-only integration profile; independent of frozen benchmark

equals.optional: optional/nullable operands require exact declared shapes; no presence refinement

finite-domain predicate.accepts: compositions of typed equals / not / and

select.elements: typed record and other typed elements; guarded predicate still bounded

order.accepts: sequence<record> with required string/integer keys; instant in separate R5.24 interpreting prototype
order.elements: record with typed required key fields
order.outcome: exact multiset and nondecreasing keys; ties free
order.generation: yes for string/integer slot-bound sources; instant unsupported in locked generator
order.verifier: yes for locked generator's keys; instant prototype not integrated

fallback.optional: absence only; present null preserved when T is nullable
fallback.refinement: presence tested by key existence at evaluation

default_missing.accepts: collection<record with optional field>, matching typed value, string identity
default_missing.optional: fills absent key, preserves present null
default_missing.state: same declared state shape, optionally record collection projection

exact_frame insertion.accepts: sequence<record> and record of exact declared shape

replace_field.accepts: sequence<record>, string identity match, field's exact declared type

post_equals.accepts: record state field, matching typed expression

sole/project.accepts: sequence<T> exactly one; record and required fields

operation outcomes.accepts: guard boolean, branch value of exact declared type
operation outcomes.optional: no branch-dependent narrowing of optional fields
operation outcomes.state: one input and one state declaration for pre/post

durable migration.accepts: compatible default_missing and post_equals relation set
durable migration.elements: optional legacy row fields in same collection
durable migration.state: one state shape for pre/post; no envelope promotion

r5_26_integration.profile: benchmark.semantic.type_integration_r5_26, contract version R5.26; previous relation entries describe the unchanged historical generator

instant -> order.condition: required instant key, chronological UTC comparison; ties unconstrained

optional<T> + present -> T relation.condition: same stable field reference within one conjunction or direct selection presence; string/integer/instant demonstrated

optional<instant> + present + before + s.condition: ordered key present in the selection population

optional<T> without matching presence.condition: a relation demanding T cannot consume optional<T>

optional<nullable<instant>> + present +.condition: presence eliminates optional only, not nullable

order on unselected optional key.condition: no ordering defined for an absent key

R5.26 writing transition.condition: this versioned integration profile only generates read-only preserve branches; historical generator retains its own transition support

R5.26 nested ordered outcomes.condition: semantic tie verifier covers a top-level ordering outcome, not arbitrary nested ordering expressions

malformed input typed outcomes.condition: separate R5.23 coherence class; not studied in R5.26

cross-shape migration.condition: separate R5.23 coherence class; not implemented in R5.26
